scenario_summary: Customer is reporting an unrecognized $76 charge and requesting an investigation or refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Linh Nguyen and I'm 66. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Okay, I see. Can you tell me the exact date and the merchant name for that $76 charge?
It was on the 14th, and the merchant is listed as 'Global Tech Services'.
Right. I'm looking at your account now. Are you sure you didn't buy anything online recently? People often forget subscriptions.
I'm quite certain. I don't have any subscriptions with that name. Can you please check if it's a legitimate merchant?
Look, I don't have time to investigate every merchant name. If you don't recognize it, I'll just open a dispute case for you. What is your account number again?
I'm sorry, I actually mentioned my account number in the secure chat portal before we started this session. It's 8829-4401.
Whatever. I've opened the dispute case for that transaction. You'll hear from the fraud department in 7 to 10 business days.

escalation_reason: Agent failed to perform basic verification or investigation, defaulting to a dispute filing instead of checking transaction details, and pushed the resolution to the fraud department.

judge_scores.justification: The agent demonstrated poor performance across all dimensions by dismissing the customer's concerns, refusing to investigate, and asking for an account number already provided in the secure chat. Instead of taking reasonable action within authority, the agent abruptly filed a dispute and transferred the issue with a curt tone and no policy grounding.
